description: This bar chart, from the paper "MMAR: A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio, Music, and Their Mix," illustrates the accuracy percentages for two categories—“Audio” and “Noise”—across three different models: “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni.” The vertical y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10. The horizontal x-axis lists the three model names in order from left to right. For each model, there are two bars: a solid blue bar representing “Audio” and a solid purple bar representing “Noise.” A dashed gray line is drawn horizontally across the chart at the 30% accuracy level, serving as a reference. The “Audio” bars show values of approximately 30% for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, 37% for Audio-Reasoner, and 58% for Qwen-2.5-Omni. The corresponding “Noise” bars show values of approximately 24% for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, 30% for Audio-Reasoner, and 36% for Qwen-2.5-Omni. The bars are not sorted by value and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis. The legend in the top-left corner clearly distinguishes the blue bar as “Audio” and the purple bar as “Noise.”
